gloss: to become fed up; to get sick of; to become disgusted

definitions.gloss: to become fed up with; to get sick of; to become disgusted
definitions.explanation: To reach a point where one can no longer tolerate something and feels strong aversion or weariness toward it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{嫌|いや}になった。
examples.english: I got fed up with my job.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧こと⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}し→繰り返し：10320_kurikaeshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{嫌|いや}になる。
examples.english: Repeating the same thing every day makes me sick of it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{優柔不断|ゆうじゅうふだん}→優柔不断：16842_yuujuufudan⟧さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{嫌|いや}になること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Sometimes I get disgusted with my own indecisiveness.

notes:
A very common and natural expression in everyday Japanese. Conveys a strong sense of weariness, frustration, or disgust. Can be directed at situations, people, or oneself.

USAGE:
The thing one is fed up with is marked by が: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{嫌|いや}になる. It can also express self-directed frustration: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{嫌|いや}になる (to become disgusted with oneself).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{嫌|いや}になる: to become fed up with X
- {嫌|いや}になるほど: to the point of being sick of it
- ⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧{嫌|いや}になった: I've had enough already

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦うんざりする→うんざりする：20665_unzarisuru⟧: to be fed up — stronger emphasis on boredom and exhaustion
- ⟦{飽|あ}きる→飽きる：01815_akiru⟧: to get tired of — emphasizes loss of interest rather than aversion
- ⟦{懲|こ}りる→懲りる：07569_koriru⟧: to learn one's lesson — implies being fed up after a bad experience
